name: Bharat Coking Coal Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1972, Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL) is engaged in the production of coking coal, non-coking coal, and washed coal. [1]
key_points: Business Profile [1] BCCL is engaged in mining, beneficiation (washing), and supply of coking coal, non-coking coal and washed coal, catering mainly to the steel and power sectors. It operates in the Jharia (Jharkhand) and Raniganj (West Bengal) coalfields and holds some of the largest prime coking coal reserves in the country.

profile.summary: Bharat Coking Coal Limited produces and sells coal in India. The company offers coking coal, non-coking coal, and washed coking and power coal products, as well as rejects and slurries. Its products are used in power, steel, cement, fertilizer, and glass manufacturing applications. The company serves the power and non-power sectors. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Dhanbad, India. Bharat Coking Coal Limited operates as a subsidiary of Coal India Limited.
